text: Agreed to pace rolling endurance rides steadily on climbs without surging, guided by conversational breathing and comfortable cadence through the middle hours.
The final riser felt harder than usual; this was attributed to riding into a headwind after a long day on the feet, not to a negative fitness trend.
For the exposed river stretch, agreed to tuck lower into the wind, move snacks earlier to support the final hour, and monitor hand and shoulder comfort as volume increases.
Kept the back-to-back ride plan unchanged because mild second-day heaviness cleared after 20 minutes; if it persists beyond 30 minutes in future, shorten the second ride rather than push through.
Set the fueling routine for rides over two hours at one bottle per hour and a bite every 30 minutes, with a larger breakfast before sustained climbing; practice the routine on easy rides first.
Recovery spins will start from the park side of town because fewer junctions help keep effort genuinely easy; agreed to protect easy days even when the schedule is busy.
